type_28_parameter_83_sweep.reading: state 4 uses ordinary top-only $8814 support. First top support sets +$27=$80; the script-loaded +$1E=$50 counts down, then +$27=$FF. Falling adds $0030 gravity before moving and tests/carries after moving. Parameter bit 7 enables the shared eight-pixel weight sag.
